approvedScope: Item 2 complete callable executor SOURCE requirements only; no concrete resource votes, wallet/observation, live reachability, store adoption, action command, role/contract/fee values or actual loan result

findings.title: validate_current fixture path vs real accounting producer
findings.requirementsGap: The injected validate_current interface is fully specified and fixture-testable, while its production body accounting.validate_executor_context is reviewed separately. Spec correctly forbids always-refusing stub or caller-supplied approval; implementation must use calculable isolated context/store/ownership fixtures for the interface and must not substitute a mock for the producer's approval. This is a deferred dependency, not a source-contract gap.

findings.title: Socket filesystem visibility under strong containment
findings.requirementsGap: Handoff requires the child to open the same-UID AF_UNIX socket inside the evidence directory in addition to inheriting MORIARTY_INVOCATION_SOCKET/NONCE. Spec obligates source-level Foreman inspection and an isolated launcher test to establish inherited-channel behavior and returns CONTAINMENT_UNSUPPORTED otherwise; implementer must confirm the socket path (not only env vars) is reachable through the pinned strong-mode launcher, and pin that launcher source in the manifest.

findings.title: write_exclusive vs collector-internal persistence boundary
findings.requirementsGap: Dependencies include write_exclusive, while the installed collector retains its own os.open/fsync ordering that injected transports must not replace. Implementation should keep collector persistence intact and route only executor-owned writes (result, receipts, cleanup intent) through the injected writer, preserving the specified persistence-ordering and final-classification predicates.

limitations: Requirements-adequacy review of supplied text only. I did not recompute candidateSha256 or per-file SHA-256 and did not access head 89b0c7b; no tools or side effects used.
cli.py::cmd_run, store functions and runner.py were read as current-caller context; foreman-launch.js was not supplied, so socket/env inheritance rests on spec obligations and runner.py.
Nothing was imported or executed, including the historical execute-once.py and collector tests; stated offline passes were not observed.

Approval is source-contract sufficiency for item 2 only. It grants no source-byte approval, resource vote, live admission or actual financial-result acceptance; both source auditors (this and Grok 4.6 high) remain required, and item 3 instance prerequisites stay open.
